pure_gas_cache.N2: 2025 Eq2 pure zero-density theory-fit; source table computed, not pore/brick measurement.

decision: Retain current assumed host closure; no numeric target-state comparison admitted and no formula replacement justified by these six donor rows. No further source expansion within this task.
necessary_missing_evidence: Same-material effective k with paired measurement temperature, wet/dry mass and bulk/condensed volumes or density/porosity, phase and contact/geometry metadata; pore radiation claims additionally require pore optical length.
